title: OpenBrief scenario
description: A map scenario for OpenBrief. Either a bare Scenario object, the exported file wrapper {format, version, duration, roster, scenario}, or an authoring document — the same thing with named places, relative times, macros, story beats and "keyframes": "auto", which the app resolves before playing. Times are timeline seconds; coordinates are [longitude, latitude] or {lat, lng}.

affiliation.description: Symbol frame shape; inferred from faction order/name when unset

arrowId.description: Arrow id this unit advances along during playback

rosterId.description: Roster entry this unit was placed from (enables custom 3D assets)

icon.description: Icon from the shared library (see the catalog in llms.txt), e.g. "tank", "archers", "carrier". Unknown names fall back to a generic icon for the unit type and are reported when the scenario is imported.

heading.description: Facing direction in degrees when not following an arrow

rangeKm.description: Weapon/sensor range ring in km; 0/undefined = none

appearAt.description: Seconds on the timeline when the unit appears

destroyedAt.description: Seconds on the timeline when the unit is destroyed (becomes a burning wreck)

sensorKm.description: Observation/sensor range in km: draws a terrain-aware line-of-sight area

airDefenseKm.description: Air-defense engagement range in km: draws an envelope that reacts to enemy aircraft

landAtEnd.description: Aircraft sets down at the end of its route instead of loitering

leavesAt.description: Seconds on the timeline when the unit leaves the scene (e.g. boards an aircraft)

altitudeKm.description: Orbital/very-high altitude in km: rendered in 3D space above its ground track

orbitRole.description: Orbital payload role: wide relay coverage or a narrow imaging footprint

captureAt.description: Timeline time an imaging satellite captures its target

duration.description: Seconds the arrow takes to fully draw

followRoads.description: Snap ground units on this arrow to real roads (default true)

hideLine.description: Movement path only: don't draw the arrow on the map

hideAt.description: Timeline time after which the arrow is no longer drawn

times.description: Absolute time (s) for each control point: move between them, holding when two are equal in place

route.description: Cached road route [lng, lat] through the control points

routeKey.description: Control-point signature the cached route was computed for

duration.description: Seconds the fill takes to fade in

label.description: Large watermark text drawn across the territory (e.g. "SDF")

labelAt.description: Watermark position [lng, lat]; defaults to the polygon centroid

flag.description: ISO 3166 country code: render a flag sticker instead of plain text

facility.description: Render as a facility marker (icon sticker + caption)

FacilityKind.description: Facility kinds a map label can be shown as. Icons are 24x24 stroke SVG bodies.

fromUnitId.description: Unit the missile launches from; ballistic arc is rendered in flight

launchAt.description: Launch time (s); defaults to a flight time derived from weapon type and distance

targetStrikeId.description: Target strike id for interceptor strikes

targetUnitId.description: Unit being hit: impact follows that unit's position at detonation time

salvo.description: Number of rounds in a salvo (gunship/artillery); impacts scatter around the aim point

spreadM.description: Salvo scatter radius in meters (default 120; half-length when pattern is "line")

pattern.description: Salvo spread shape. "disc" scatters rounds around the aim point (artillery sheaf — the default for ground weapons). "line" walks them along the attack axis from the firing unit toward the aim point: strafing runs, bomb sticks and rocket ripples. Needs fromUnitId. Air-launched gun, bomb and missile salvos use "line" automatically unless set to "disc".

caption.description: Slide-style caption shown while this keyframe is active

highlightUnitIds.description: Units emphasized on the map and in the caption while this keyframe is active

followUnitId.description: Camera tracks this unit while the keyframe is active

followMode.description: 'track' keeps unit centered; 'chase' also turns camera to unit heading

orbitSpeed.description: Camera orbit speed in deg/s while this keyframe is active

narrate.description: Speak this caption aloud (default true); false shows it as text only

sensor.description: Sensor view applied while this keyframe is active

aerial.description: While this keyframe is active, show the 3D aerial scene from this camera shot instead of the map

overlay.description: On-screen graphic flashed up while this keyframe is active

overlayFactionIds.description: Factions included when the order-of-battle overlay is active

anchor.description: Place the image beside this map point instead of at the screen edge

anchorRadiusM.description: Half-width of the site at the anchor in meters, so the image clears it

media.description: Full-screen image card shown while this keyframe is active

mode.description: chase: behind the target; side: beside it; flyby: fixed point it passes; overview: orbit above the fight; compare: the target and secondary aircraft side by side on turntables with a stats panel (pair it with a hold)

target.description: Aircraft the camera follows or frames

distanceM.description: Camera distance in meters (defaults per mode)

orbitDegPerS.description: Degrees per second the overview orbits

note.description: Small print under the panel, e.g. that figures are approximate

compare.description: Stats panel for the compare shot: target on the left, secondary on the right

AerialShot.description: Camera for a keyframe in the aerial scene.

bars.description: Numbers for [left, right] to draw proportional bars (same unit on both sides)

AerialCompareRow.description: One line of an aircraft comparison: a value for each aircraft and optional bar sizes.

ShotOverlay.description: On-screen graphics a keyframe can flash up over the map.

start.description: Seconds on the timeline when the effect starts

StatusEffect.description: A timed status/activity shown on a unit (radio call, jamming, panic…).

endHour.description: Local hour at timeline end; may be less than start to cross midnight

date.description: Calendar date at timeline start (YYYY-MM-DD) for sun position

utcOffset.description: Local time zone offset from UTC in hours (e.g. 5 for Pakistan)

hourKeys.description: Optional piecewise clock: [timeline seconds, local hours since start day] pairs (hours may exceed 24), e.g. to cut from night to the next morning. Overrides the linear start→end mapping.

windDirDeg.description: Direction the wind blows toward, compass degrees

cloudCover.description: Cloud cover 0..1: flattens and greys the light, mutes golden hour

precipitation.description: Falling weather drawn over the scene

Environment.description: Lighting and weather over the scenario timeline.

Period.description: Historical period. The authoring content — icons, packs, macros, guidance and examples — is split along these, so an author only ever sees material that belongs together. `era` remains the visual treatment; see eras.ts.

holds.description: Explanatory freezes: at timeline second `at`, aircraft hold for `seconds`

terrain.description: Ground: "real" builds the actual terrain around `origin` from elevation data; the others are stylized textures on flat ground (default plain).

terrainTexture.description: Texture draped on real terrain: "basemap" is our map with every name, road, border and building removed; "satellite" is cloud-free Sentinel-2 imagery (shows the present-day landscape). Default basemap.

terrainRadiusKm.description: Half-width of the real-terrain square in km (default 30)

AerialScene.description: A 3D air-combat reconstruction, in a local frame anchored at `origin`. Aircraft times are flight seconds; `holds` pause the aircraft (not the camera) for explanation, so flight time falls behind timeline time.

AerialStyle.description: Visual treatment of the 3D aerial scene.

track.description: Flight path as [flight seconds, meters east, meters north, meters altitude] relative to the scene origin. Points are smoothed; bank and pitch come from the curvature, so sample every second or two through maneuvers.

destroyedAt.description: Flight time the aircraft is shot down: it falls trailing smoke from here

AerialAircraft.description: One aircraft in the aerial scene.

duration.description: Seconds the burst lasts, or the missile flies (default 1.2 guns, 3 missile)

hit.description: Missile hits its target at the end of its flight (default true)

AerialWeapon.description: Guns burst or missile shot between aircraft. Times are flight seconds.

ArticleBlock.description: One block of the article presentation. A scene embeds the map and plays the timeline from keyframe `from` up to the keyframe that follows `to` (or the end), holding on its last frame.

name.description: Also drives the unit silhouette, e.g. "T-72 Tank", "AH-64 Apache", "MQ-9 Reaper".

icon.description: Icon library key used by units placed from this entry.

iconImage.description: Custom map icon: an image URL, or "asset:<id>" for an upload.

environment.description: Lighting & weather; optional (defaults to midday, calm, clear)

narrationPack.description: Folder of pre-recorded caption narration (with manifest.json), relative to the site base

subtitle.description: Standfirst under the article headline, e.g. "Deir ez-Zor, Syria · 7–8 February 2018"

sources.description: References listed at the end of the article, e.g. "US Department of Defense briefing, 13 February 2018"

era.description: Visual era. "historical" hides modern map features (roads, buildings, borders, place labels), uses an aged parchment palette, and drops modern interface elements; for events before the modern period.

period.description: Historical period; selects content packs and implies `era`

aerial.description: 3D air-combat scene shown by keyframes that set `aerial`

article.description: Article presentation: prose with embedded map scenes. Generated from captions when absent

keyframes.description: "auto" composes the camera from `beats` (or from the events themselves)

beats.description: Story beats the camera composer turns into shots

macros.description: Structures expanded into units, routes and strikes

near.description: Position relative to another object or place

Beat.description: One story beat. The author writes what happens and who matters; the camera composer works out where to put the camera, how wide to frame it and how long the shot needs to be for the caption to be read aloud.

ShotKind.description: Which kind of shot the camera composer should build for a beat.

via.description: The route, as places, ids, offsets or literal [lng, lat]

spacingSeconds.description: Seconds between vehicles entering the route (default 2)

duration.description: Seconds the lead element takes to run the route

ColumnMacro.description: A moving column: `count` units queued along one route, spaced in time.

UnitTemplate.description: Fields shared by the units a macro stamps out.

shape.description: line and shieldwall spread across the frontage; wedge and column go back from it

facingDeg.description: Direction the formation faces, compass degrees (default 0)

frontageM.description: Width of the formation in metres (default 400)

FormationMacro.description: A static formation: units laid out around a centre point.

targets.description: Unit ids, place names or points being hit, in order

weapon.description: Weapon name, used for the strike name and its flight timing

StrikePackageMacro.description: One shooter engaging several targets in sequence.

VolleyMacro.description: Pre-modern massed ranged fire: repeated volleys onto one target area.

include.description: Content packs to merge in: "modern/nato", or any URL

places.description: Named anchor points, shared by everything in the document

AuthoringDocument.description: The document an author (or an assistant) writes. Everything except `scenario` is optional, and a plain exported scenario file is also a valid authoring document — the sugar is additive.

effects.description: Unit status effects; optional for older scenarios

environment.description: Lighting & weather; optional (defaults to midday, calm, clear)

narrationPack.description: Folder of pre-recorded caption narration (with manifest.json), relative to the site base

period.description: Historical period the scenario is authored in. Selects the content packs, icons and guidance an author is offered, and implies `era` when that is not set. See eras.ts.
